# Database reference

41 tables in the `public` schema of the Supabase Postgres database, from the SQLAlchemy models in `apps/api/app/models/`.
Migrations are in `apps/api/migrations/versions/` (Alembic). Sign-in accounts live in Supabase's own `auth.users`; `profiles.auth_user_id` points at them (not as a database foreign key).

**Row Level Security is enabled on every table** with no public policies, so the browser key can read and write nothing; the API connects as the table owner. `apps/api/tests/test_rls.py` fails if a table is missing it.
